facts.text: Yuki is a fictional resident whose complete showroom is rebuilt unchanged on every Explore-mode launch and is not used for authenticated users.
Her stated setting is Japan; nbhd does not name her city or prefecture.
English fixture copy uses Japanese place, food, and literature cues including Osaka, Yoshimoto's *Kitchen*, ryokan, Arashiyama, tempura, miso, and shiso.
nbhd does not state which languages she speaks or her fluency.
Yuki logs an easy 6 km run, an 8/10 mood, and short sleep; the assistant connects these to Osaka training and winding down.
Saved chat prompts revisit yesterday's journal, plan an evening, track sleep, and ask what the app remembers.
Her notes track runs, work focus, mood, sleep, dinners, reading, and plans over several days.
She is preparing for an Osaka 10K with three runs a week, aims to read twelve books in a year, and plans her parents' September visit.
Active tasks include a gym renewal, race photos for Mika, and a dentist booking; completed tasks include a client deck and landlord call.
Fuel shows an interval run, an easy 6 km, and a planned long 10 km in the current week.
Today's meal fixture is miso-glazed salmon with rice and spinach, described as light before the next interval session.
Her stated purpose joins calm, strength, shipping work, physical capability, and showing up for people in Japan.
Named values favor consistency over intensity and saying kind things aloud; session titles emphasize gentle restarting and room for what matters.
Two posts from Mika show an 8 km achievement credited to Yuki's pacing advice and a Sunday market moment.
Her chat voice is compact, lower-case, conversational, and candid about exercise, mood, and sleep.
Her journal voice is brisk and specific: distances, ratings, sleep duration, work boundaries, food, and reading progress sit together without ceremony.
Her plans mix practical follow-through with warmth toward friends and family.
nbhd never defines household size, dietary identity, allergies, cooking frequency, or budget currency.
nbhd never says she follows a football club or acts as a fan, parent, player, or scout.
nbhd never establishes age, occupation title, income, hometown, relationship status, or whether Mika or her parents share her home.
Household size: 1. A single-person seed makes quantities deterministic while the fixtures leave co-residence unstated.
Diet: pescatarian; allergies: none recorded. This seeds the shown salmon meal without claiming medical or broader food preferences.
Cooking habit: simple weeknight dinners, three times weekly. This creates planning repetition without claiming she cooked the fixture meal.
Budget currency: JPY. This matches the stated Japanese setting while leaving amount and limits undecided.
Followed club: Cerezo Osaka. This supplies a concrete Japanese club and loosely echoes the documented Osaka goal without claiming allegiance.
Role: fan, rather than parent, player, or scout. This adds the least professional or family biography while enabling follow and watch journeys.
